label: PF Backlog 562
title: Worker-delivered PRs satisfy FEATURE_PR gates: review/lint/structure run-bound records on work complete
body:
## Why
IS-PF-0037 cause (2): the manual/session worker completes (status verifying) but never produces the run-bound
gate records FEATURE_PR requires, so worker PRs can never pass lane-driven delivery (human PRs do via their
recorders). Equivalent gates, same standard.

## What
- work complete (manual + auto) runs the gate recorders in the worktree before handing to the lane:
  lint record, code-review record (self/agent review), spec-review record, structure_contract checklist,
  close-loop artifact/tests/compliance/go-no-go inputs; attach usage/timing.
- manual mode: PAUSE for operator approval with the gate summary before completing (already in protocol).

## Where
workergrid/wg.py work complete path, PF recorders (scripts/dev + core), delivery integration.

## Verify
- e2e: worker-completes -> all FEATURE_PR records present -> validation PASS -> merge -> provenance.
